name: codex-discord-bridge
description: Control Codex CLI from Discord. A Rust serenity bridge that connects a Discord bot to the Codex app-server over WebSocket: mention the bot, it spawns a Codex thread, output streams back live, approvals arrive as buttons, and every Discord thread maps 1:1 to a Codex conversation.

interface.shortDescription: Control Codex CLI from Discord, from anywhere
interface.longDescription: Run Codex without sitting at your PC. This plugin documents and validates the codex-discord-bridge setup: a Discord bot (Rust, serenity) that speaks JSON-RPC over WebSocket to the Codex app-server on your machine. Messages in a Discord thread become Codex turns, agent output streams back live, approval requests appear as Discord buttons, and the Discord thread to Codex thread mapping survives disconnects via a bounded supervisor.
defaultPrompt: Help me set up the codex-discord-bridge bot for my Discord server
